title: green minimalist professional business proposal
source: Green minimalist professional Business Proposal Presentation.pptx
overall_deck_description: This professional business proposal deck is designed around a modern corporate aesthetic featuring a clean palette of deep forest green, crisp white, light grey accents, and warm-toned lifestyle photography. Typography relies on bold, geometric sans-serif headers paired with clean, readable sans-serif body text. Across the deck, consistent framing devices tie the sequence together: solid green framing bands, subtle dot-matrix accent grids, circular icon badges, and rounded pill-shaped containers for sequential lists and milestones. Slide 0 serves as a bold cover introducing the proposal alongside company branding, slides 1 through 11 carry structured body content ranging from timelines and multi-column breakdowns to section dividers, and slide 12 concludes with a balanced contact and closing layout echoing the cover's visual language.
